# Product document for `scen-check-fix-records-term`.
#
# Its concepts cover every step of E2E-001, and the glossary defines
# every term they declare but "reply"; the fix adds the entry that
# defines it.

title: "Fixture host project"

description:
  summary: >-
    A single MCP service, used by the true-bdd fixtures as the host
    project a scenario registry describes.

roles:
  - name: Operator
    definition: Runs the MCP service and watches what it answers.
  - name: Client Developer
    definition: Writes the clients that send the MCP service its requests.

glossary:
  - term: mcp service
    means: >-
      The service this project builds: it takes a message from a client
      and answers it. What every Scenario of the project observes.
  - term: message
    means: >-
      One request a client sends the MCP service, as text. The service
      answers each message on its own.
  - term: reply
    means: >-
      The text the MCP service answers a message with: one reply per
      message, as text.

concepts:
  given:
    - concept: service running
      means: The MCP service has started and accepts requests.
      terms: [mcp service]
  when:
    - concept: message sent
      means: A role sends a stated message to the MCP service, once.
      terms: [mcp service, message]
  then:
    - concept: answer
      means: The MCP service's reply to the message is exactly a stated text.
      terms: [mcp service, reply]
